name: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd
about: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd. designs manufacture and sells a range of gold, studded and other jewellery products across various price points. It is one of the largest jewellery retailers in India based on revenue as of FY20. The co. was founded by the current Chairman, MD and Promoter, Mr T.S. Kalyanaraman [1]
keyPoints: Business Profile:[1] Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd, established in 1993, is one of India's largest organised jewellery retailers. The company runs a pan-India, hyperlocal retail model with a scaled presence across India, the Middle East and the USA.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 195% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 20.5%
cons: Stock is trading at 10.8 times its book value

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome 11 Nov - Kalyan Jewellers shared Q2 FY2026-27 earnings conference call recording online.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 10 Nov - Kalyan Jewellers reported H1 FY27 revenue of Rs 20,912 crore and PAT of Rs 776 crore.

Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For Financial Results For The Quarter Ended On 30 September 2026 10 Nov - Approved Q2/H1 FY27 results ended 30 Sep 2026; standalone PAT ₹424 crore, consolidated PAT ₹427 crore.
